Soundtrack

Music: checking…. Add tracks named track02.ogg through track11.ogg (other audio formats also work).

Touch: drag on the left to move, drag on the right or Fire to look. Use Jump, Weapon, Menu, and Scores.

Keyboard: WASD moves, Mouse looks and fires, Space jumps, Tab shows scores, Esc opens this menu, and ~ opens the engine console.

Open Menu for new games, saves, multiplayer, settings, and controls. This web build uses a single browser menu in place of Quake's desktop menus.
The installed shareware contains episode 1. Before launching, open Full game files & soundtrack and select pak0.pak and pak1.pak from your purchased copy for the full campaign.
On iPhone, use Install for instructions to open Quake from the Home Screen without the browser address bar. Export and import saves if moving between the browser and that app.
The original shareware is available as a complete, unchanged archive, with its original license.

Play without the address bar
On iPhone, open this site in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Keep Open as Web App enabled, tap Add, and launch Quake from the new Home Screen icon.
In a regular iPhone browser tab, Expand game fills the available view; it cannot remove the browser's address bar.
Before switching, export saves from Menu → Save & load. Import them in the Home Screen app if they aren't already there.
